::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="No project values yet? Start with standard cases"}

- **[Cooling period](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-cooling_period):** Choose a period matching the intended use.

- **[Cooling system](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-cooling_system):** Several standard cases cover reversible heat pumps, including a configuration with a FreeCooling share.

- **[Cooled uses](preset-catalog.qmd#preset-cooling_modes):** If only non-residential areas should be cooled, check [Kühlung in Nicht-Wohn-Nutzungen]{.excel-value} (cooling in non-residential uses).

Check the applied values for your project. [How to apply presets](presets.qmd).

:::
